responsibilities: Author standardized PRD/Spec artifact with explicit acceptance criteria
Score business impact and token ROI before scheduling work
Bind product intent contract (.intent/contract.yaml) to verifiable commands
Implement minimal change in an isolated git worktree off origin/main
Write behavioral unit + E2E tests asserting literal user-visible outputs
Execute sideways enterprise guardrails before opening PR
Verify diff against golden examples and blast-radius invariants
Audit per-PR defect/regression signals before merge
Require live post-merge/deploy receipt (SHA, HTTP 200, OTel span)

tribalKnowledgeSemanticLayer.rule: Enforce a hard $10/month ceiling on metered LLM APIs; prefer $0 local Apple Silicon (Ollama/Lemonade) or flat-rate coding plans first.
Fail closed on any corporate hostname or identifier matching CORP_AIRGAP_RE before writing telemetry, public docs, or RAG memories.
Every LinkedIn, Bluesky, X, or Reddit post must pass tools/social-publish-gate.js before publish and tools/verify-public-post.js after publish.
Never edit a file claimed by another agent in plan.md; always branch off origin/main in an isolated worktree and use merge=union on append-only logs.
Only link verified HTTP 200 checkout slugs (Gumroad /l/vcrho $49 Pro, /l/odrkon $9.99 Playbook, /l/nllmvb $9 Solo; ThumbGate https://thumbgate.app; Dayglass https://dayglass.io).

prd_spec.title: Add Streamable HTTP MCP Discovery & Claude Connector Annotations
prd_spec.problemStatement: Enterprise AI marketplaces (Claude Connectors, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT, Grok, Perplexity) reject MCP servers that lack readOnlyHint/destructiveHint annotations or /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
prd_spec.targetUser: Developers & CTOs installing Mac YOLO Safeguards, ThumbGate, and Dayglass connectors.
prd_spec.businessValue: Unlocks direct SaaS distribution across 7 AI connector marketplaces ($9-$499 self-serve funnel).
acceptanceCriteria: All 12 MCP tools include title and annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint).
GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json returns HTTP 200 with valid server schema.
